summary: PowerShell code is well-structured (Set-StrictMode, error handling, clear naming), workflow uses pinned refs and least-privilege permissions. However, deliverable is fundamentally incomplete: (1) TEST FILE missing entirely—task requires Pester tests written first via red/green TDD; none provided. (2) TEST FIXTURES absent—workflow references tests/LicenseChecker.Tests.ps1, fixtures/mock-licenses.json, config/license-config.json, test-input/ manifests; none exist. Cannot run as-is. (3) No actionlint validation output (task requirement). (4) No act execution results; act-result.txt required artifact is missing. (5) No evidence of TDD process (failing test → minimum code → refactor). Maintainability scored 2 because tests cannot verify actual testability/mock behavior. Overall: code quality ~4/5, but deliverable incompleteness ~2/5. Not shippable; missing core task requirements.
